data.motivesAndTactics: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks

features.name: Shadow's Embrace
features.text: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. **Mark a Stress** to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

features.name: Pick Off the Straggler
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily _Vulnerable_. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.
